infrastructure.name: docker-compose.yaml
infrastructure.summary: Defines the multi-service local stack for project_works: the Go backend (built from the Dockerfile), a PostgreSQL 16 database with a health check and persistent volume, and a SeaweedFS S3-compatible file storage service, all wired over a shared bridge network.

infrastructure.name: backend
infrastructure.summary: Go backend API service built from the local Dockerfile, exposed on port 8088. Configured via environment variables for the Postgres DSN, SeaweedFS file store endpoint/bucket, session secret, and super-admin credentials; waits for the database to be healthy before starting.

infrastructure.name: database
infrastructure.summary: PostgreSQL 16 (alpine) service exposing port 5432, with a pg_isready health check and a persistent volume under ./local_storage_data/postgres backing the project_works database.

infrastructure.name: file_storage
infrastructure.summary: SeaweedFS service running in S3 mode (server -s3) to provide S3-compatible object storage for attachments, exposing the S3 API (8333), master (9333), and filer web UI (8888) with a persistent data volume.

infrastructure.name: Dockerfile
infrastructure.summary: Multi-stage Docker build that compiles the Go backend in a golang:1.26-alpine builder stage (static CGO-disabled binary from ./cmd/server) and copies the binary and migrations into a minimal alpine:3.20 runtime image exposing port 8088.

infrastructure.name: builder
infrastructure.summary: First build stage based on golang:1.26-alpine that downloads modules, tidies dependencies, and compiles the backend into a static linux binary at /build/project-works-server.

infrastructure.name: alpine
infrastructure.summary: Final runtime stage based on alpine:3.20 that installs ca-certificates and tzdata, copies the compiled server binary and migrations from the builder stage, exposes port 8088, and runs the server as the entrypoint.

infrastructure.name: package.yml
infrastructure.summary: Currently empty GitHub Actions workflow placeholder, presumably reserved for a future packaging or release pipeline.

infrastructure.name: tests.yml
infrastructure.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that builds a test Docker image and runs the unit-test suite (via 'just unit-test-ci') on pushes and pull requests targeting the dev branch, then uploads JSON/Markdown test reports as artifacts.

infrastructure.name: Dockerfile_tests
infrastructure.summary: Builds the test container image from golang:1.26-alpine, installing just/gotestsum and tooling, then compiling the integration-test binary used to run unit and integration tests in CI and locally.

data.name: 00001_create_extensions.sql
data.summary: First migration that enables required PostgreSQL extensions (such as pgcrypto/uuid generation) used by all subsequent schema migrations.

data.name: 00002_create_users_and_groups.sql
data.summary: Defines the authentication and authorization core: users, groups, group memberships, and API keys with their indexes.

data.name: 00003_create_projects.sql
data.summary: Creates the project hierarchy: projects with folder paths, group-based project access control, and project phases.

data.name: 00004_create_elements.sql
data.summary: Central migration defining the polymorphic elements table (requirements, features, tasks, bugs, etc.) plus element supervisors and requirement clients, with full-text search and lookup indexes.

data.name: 00005_create_element_links.sql
data.summary: Defines the element_links table modeling typed relationships (related, child, implement) between any two elements, with source and destination indexes.

data.name: 00006_create_custom_fields.sql
data.summary: Implements user-defined custom fields: per-project field definitions scoped by element type and the corresponding per-element field values.

data.name: 00007_create_attachments.sql
data.summary: Creates the element_attachments table storing file metadata (storage key, name, size, content type) for files attached to elements in external object storage.

data.name: 00008_create_element_versions.sql
data.summary: Adds git-like version history for elements: element_versions snapshots, forward patch storage, and pending-change tracking for unsaved edits.

data.name: users
data.summary: Stores user accounts including external identity provider and subject for Office 365/OIDC single sign-on.

data.name: groups
data.summary: Defines access-control groups to which users are assigned and through which project access is granted.

data.name: group_memberships
data.summary: Join table mapping users to the groups they belong to.

data.name: api_keys
data.summary: Stores hashed API keys tied to a user for CLI and automation access to the backend.

data.name: projects
data.summary: Top-level projects with name, description, and folder path for multi-depth navigation.

data.name: group_project_access
data.summary: Grants groups an access level to specific projects, implementing group-level project authorization.

data.name: phases
data.summary: Ordered project phases with planned start/end dates used for scheduling tasks (Gantt/PERT).

data.name: elements
data.summary: Polymorphic core table holding all element types (requirements, features, tasks, bugs, evaluations, risks) with self-referential parent feature and phase references.

data.name: element_supervisors
data.summary: Join table linking elements to the users who supervise them (requirement/feature reference persons).

data.name: requirement_clients
data.summary: Stores client contacts (name, email, notes) associated with requirement elements.

data.name: element_links
data.summary: Typed directed links (related, child, implement) between a source and destination element, enabling coupling and dependency views.

data.name: custom_field_definitions
data.summary: Per-project definitions of custom fields, scoped by element type, with field type, options, and display order.

data.name: element_custom_field_values
data.summary: Stores the custom field values for individual elements against their field definitions.

data.name: element_attachments
data.summary: File attachment metadata for elements, referencing files held in external object storage by storage key.

data.name: element_versions
data.summary: Immutable version snapshots of an element, recording content SHA, version number, committer, and commit message.

data.name: element_version_patches
data.summary: Stores the forward patch payload for each element version to reconstruct content diffs/history.

data.name: element_pending_changes
data.summary: Tracks an element's unsaved/in-progress edits and a snapshot taken before editing for draft recovery.

data.name: openapi.yaml
data.summary: OpenAPI 3 specification defining the complete backend REST contract: auth, projects and folders, elements, links, versions and diffs, attachments, custom field definitions and values, phases, users, groups and membership, project access control, and API keys.

data.name: auth
data.summary: Authentication endpoints: OAuth login, callback, logout, and current-user (/auth/login, /auth/callback, /auth/logout, /auth/me).

data.name: projects
data.summary: Project and folder management endpoints including listing, creation, folder hierarchy, and per-project retrieval/update (/projects, /projects/folders, /projects/{project_identifier}).

data.name: elements
data.summary: Element CRUD and search endpoints scoped to a project, plus standalone element access (/projects/{project_identifier}/elements, /elements/{element_identifier}, /elements/search).

data.name: links
data.summary: Element link management endpoints for creating links from an element and operating on a single link (/elements/{element_identifier}/links, /links/{link_identifier}).

data.name: versions
data.summary: Element version history endpoints: list versions, fetch a specific version, and diff between versions (/elements/{element_identifier}/versions[/{version_number}][/diff]).

data.name: attachments
data.summary: File attachment endpoints for listing/uploading on an element and accessing a single attachment (/elements/{element_identifier}/attachments, /attachments/{attachment_identifier}).

data.name: custom-fields
data.summary: Custom field endpoints covering per-project field definitions and per-element field values (/projects/{project_identifier}/custom-field-definitions, /elements/{element_identifier}/custom-field-values).

data.name: phases
data.summary: Project phase endpoints for listing/creating phases and operating on a single phase (/projects/{project_identifier}/phases, /phases/{phase_identifier}).

data.name: users
data.summary: User management endpoints for listing users, single-user access, and a user's group memberships (/users, /users/{user_identifier}, /users/{user_identifier}/groups).

data.name: groups
data.summary: Group endpoints covering group CRUD, membership management, and group access listings (/groups, /groups/{group_identifier}, /groups/{group_identifier}/members[/{user_identifier}], /groups/{group_identifier}/access).

data.name: access
data.summary: Project access-control endpoints for granting/revoking group access to projects and checking access (/projects/{project_identifier}/access[/{group_identifier}], /projects/{project_identifier}/access/check).

data.name: api-keys
data.summary: API key endpoints for listing/creating automation keys and operating on a single key (/api-keys, /api-keys/{api_key_identifier}).

config.name: config.yaml
config.summary: Runtime configuration for the backend covering server host/port, database connection, file storage, cache, authentication (including super-admin local account), and versioning behavior.

list.name: API Layer
list.description: HTTP request handling via go-chi and Huma — route registration, request/response binding, and the OpenAPI interface consumed by the frontend and CLI.

list.name: Authentication & Authorization
list.description: Office 365 OIDC login, API keys for automation, sessions, super-admin fallback, and the middleware enforcing group-based project access.

list.name: Service Layer
list.description: Business logic and orchestration including the git-like versioning subsystem (snapshots, patches, async version worker) that sits between handlers and stores.

list.name: Domain & Store Interfaces
list.description: Core domain models (elements, requirements, features, tasks, links, phases, versions) and the pluggable store/cache/file-storage interfaces every other layer depends on.

list.name: Persistence & Storage
list.description: Concrete implementations of the domain store interfaces — PostgreSQL stores, S3 file storage, and the Ristretto in-memory read cache.

list.name: Data Schema & Migrations
list.description: PostgreSQL schema migrations and the table/schema/endpoint definitions describing the persisted data model and the OpenAPI surface.

list.name: Infrastructure & CI/CD
list.description: Docker images, Docker Compose topology (backend, database, file storage), test container, and GitHub Actions packaging/test pipelines.

list.name: Configuration & Tooling
list.description: Application config loading, the config.yaml / go.mod project config, and build/dev tooling scripts (justfile, test results parser, entry points).

list.name: Documentation
list.description: Project documentation: README, ARCHITECTURE, DATA_MODEL, backend DIAGRAM, and Claude guidance.

file:backend/internal/config/config.go.name: config.go
file:backend/internal/config/config.go.summary: Defines the layered application configuration structs (server, database, file store, cache, auth, version) and loads them from a YAML config file.

file:backend/internal/domain/element_typ.name: element_type.go
file:backend/internal/domain/element_typ.summary: Defines the ElementType enumeration (Feature, Task, Requirement, Bug, Eval, Risk) with helpers to list all types and validate a value.

file:backend/internal/domain/store_eleme.name: store_element_version.go
file:backend/internal/domain/store_eleme.summary: Declares the ElementVersionStore and ElementPendingChangeStore persistence interfaces used by the versioning subsystem.

file:backend/internal/service/custom_fie.name: custom_field_service.go
file:backend/internal/service/custom_fie.summary: Service orchestrating custom field definitions and values, persisting changes and staging pending element snapshots for versioning while invalidating cache entries.

file:backend/internal/service/group_serv.name: group_service.go
file:backend/internal/service/group_serv.summary: Thin service facade over the group and group-project-access stores, exposing group CRUD, membership management, and project access-level operations.

file:backend/internal/service/link_servi.name: link_service.go
file:backend/internal/service/link_servi.summary: Service managing element links (create, delete, update type, list), staging pending snapshots of both endpoints for versioning and invalidating their cache entries.

file:backend/internal/store/postgres/con.name: connection.go
file:backend/internal/store/postgres/con.summary: Opens and configures a Postgres connection pool and runs filesystem-based SQL migrations.

service:docker-compose.yaml.name: docker-compose.yaml
service:docker-compose.yaml.summary: Defines the multi-service local stack for project_works: the Go backend (built from the Dockerfile), a PostgreSQL 16 database with a health check and persistent volume, and a SeaweedFS S3-compatible file storage service, all wired over a shared bridge network.

service:docker-compose.yaml:backend.name: backend
service:docker-compose.yaml:backend.summary: Go backend API service built from the local Dockerfile, exposed on port 8088. Configured via environment variables for the Postgres DSN, SeaweedFS file store endpoint/bucket, session secret, and super-admin credentials; waits for the database to be healthy before starting.

service:docker-compose.yaml:database.name: database
service:docker-compose.yaml:database.summary: PostgreSQL 16 (alpine) service exposing port 5432, with a pg_isready health check and a persistent volume under ./local_storage_data/postgres backing the project_works database.

service:docker-compose.yaml:file_storage.name: file_storage
service:docker-compose.yaml:file_storage.summary: SeaweedFS service running in S3 mode (server -s3) to provide S3-compatible object storage for attachments, exposing the S3 API (8333), master (9333), and filer web UI (8888) with a persistent data volume.

service:Dockerfile.name: Dockerfile
service:Dockerfile.summary: Multi-stage Docker build that compiles the Go backend in a golang:1.26-alpine builder stage (static CGO-disabled binary from ./cmd/server) and copies the binary and migrations into a minimal alpine:3.20 runtime image exposing port 8088.

service:Dockerfile:builder.name: builder
service:Dockerfile:builder.summary: First build stage based on golang:1.26-alpine that downloads modules, tidies dependencies, and compiles the backend into a static linux binary at /build/project-works-server.

service:Dockerfile:alpine.name: alpine
service:Dockerfile:alpine.summary: Final runtime stage based on alpine:3.20 that installs ca-certificates and tzdata, copies the compiled server binary and migrations from the builder stage, exposes port 8088, and runs the server as the entrypoint.

pipeline:.github/workflows/package.yml.name: package.yml
pipeline:.github/workflows/package.yml.summary: Currently empty GitHub Actions workflow placeholder, presumably reserved for a future packaging or release pipeline.

pipeline:.github/workflows/tests.yml.name: tests.yml
pipeline:.github/workflows/tests.yml.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that builds a test Docker image and runs the unit-test suite (via 'just unit-test-ci') on pushes and pull requests targeting the dev branch, then uploads JSON/Markdown test reports as artifacts.

schema:backend/migrations/00001_create_e.name: 00001_create_extensions.sql
schema:backend/migrations/00001_create_e.summary: First migration that enables required PostgreSQL extensions (such as pgcrypto/uuid generation) used by all subsequent schema migrations.

schema:backend/migrations/00002_create_u.name: 00002_create_users_and_groups.sql
schema:backend/migrations/00002_create_u.summary: Defines the authentication and authorization core: users, groups, group memberships, and API keys with their indexes.

schema:backend/migrations/00003_create_p.name: 00003_create_projects.sql
schema:backend/migrations/00003_create_p.summary: Creates the project hierarchy: projects with folder paths, group-based project access control, and project phases.

schema:backend/migrations/00004_create_e.name: 00004_create_elements.sql
schema:backend/migrations/00004_create_e.summary: Central migration defining the polymorphic elements table (requirements, features, tasks, bugs, etc.) plus element supervisors and requirement clients, with full-text search and lookup indexes.

schema:backend/migrations/00005_create_e.name: 00005_create_element_links.sql
schema:backend/migrations/00005_create_e.summary: Defines the element_links table modeling typed relationships (related, child, implement) between any two elements, with source and destination indexes.

schema:backend/migrations/00006_create_c.name: 00006_create_custom_fields.sql
schema:backend/migrations/00006_create_c.summary: Implements user-defined custom fields: per-project field definitions scoped by element type and the corresponding per-element field values.

schema:backend/migrations/00007_create_a.name: 00007_create_attachments.sql
schema:backend/migrations/00007_create_a.summary: Creates the element_attachments table storing file metadata (storage key, name, size, content type) for files attached to elements in external object storage.

schema:backend/migrations/00008_create_e.name: 00008_create_element_versions.sql
schema:backend/migrations/00008_create_e.summary: Adds git-like version history for elements: element_versions snapshots, forward patch storage, and pending-change tracking for unsaved edits.

table:backend/migrations/00002_create_us.name: users
table:backend/migrations/00002_create_us.summary: Stores user accounts including external identity provider and subject for Office 365/OIDC single sign-on.

table:backend/migrations/00002_create_us.name: groups
table:backend/migrations/00002_create_us.summary: Defines access-control groups to which users are assigned and through which project access is granted.

table:backend/migrations/00002_create_us.name: group_memberships
table:backend/migrations/00002_create_us.summary: Join table mapping users to the groups they belong to.

table:backend/migrations/00002_create_us.name: api_keys
table:backend/migrations/00002_create_us.summary: Stores hashed API keys tied to a user for CLI and automation access to the backend.

table:backend/migrations/00003_create_pr.name: projects
table:backend/migrations/00003_create_pr.summary: Top-level projects with name, description, and folder path for multi-depth navigation.

table:backend/migrations/00003_create_pr.name: group_project_access
table:backend/migrations/00003_create_pr.summary: Grants groups an access level to specific projects, implementing group-level project authorization.

table:backend/migrations/00003_create_pr.name: phases
table:backend/migrations/00003_create_pr.summary: Ordered project phases with planned start/end dates used for scheduling tasks (Gantt/PERT).

table:backend/migrations/00004_create_el.name: elements
table:backend/migrations/00004_create_el.summary: Polymorphic core table holding all element types (requirements, features, tasks, bugs, evaluations, risks) with self-referential parent feature and phase references.

table:backend/migrations/00004_create_el.name: element_supervisors
table:backend/migrations/00004_create_el.summary: Join table linking elements to the users who supervise them (requirement/feature reference persons).

table:backend/migrations/00004_create_el.name: requirement_clients
table:backend/migrations/00004_create_el.summary: Stores client contacts (name, email, notes) associated with requirement elements.

table:backend/migrations/00005_create_el.name: element_links
table:backend/migrations/00005_create_el.summary: Typed directed links (related, child, implement) between a source and destination element, enabling coupling and dependency views.

table:backend/migrations/00006_create_cu.name: custom_field_definitions
table:backend/migrations/00006_create_cu.summary: Per-project definitions of custom fields, scoped by element type, with field type, options, and display order.

table:backend/migrations/00006_create_cu.name: element_custom_field_values
table:backend/migrations/00006_create_cu.summary: Stores the custom field values for individual elements against their field definitions.

table:backend/migrations/00007_create_at.name: element_attachments
table:backend/migrations/00007_create_at.summary: File attachment metadata for elements, referencing files held in external object storage by storage key.

table:backend/migrations/00008_create_el.name: element_versions
table:backend/migrations/00008_create_el.summary: Immutable version snapshots of an element, recording content SHA, version number, committer, and commit message.

table:backend/migrations/00008_create_el.name: element_version_patches
table:backend/migrations/00008_create_el.summary: Stores the forward patch payload for each element version to reconstruct content diffs/history.

table:backend/migrations/00008_create_el.name: element_pending_changes
table:backend/migrations/00008_create_el.summary: Tracks an element's unsaved/in-progress edits and a snapshot taken before editing for draft recovery.

document:ARCHITECTURE.md.name: ARCHITECTURE.md
document:ARCHITECTURE.md.summary: Architecture and technology design document describing the Go backend layered/clean architecture, React+TypeScript frontend, repository layout, CQRS-lite read model, plugin system, OpenAPI-first API, custom fields, auth flow, and deployment targets.

document:Claude.md.name: Claude.md
document:Claude.md.summary: Product and domain specification covering the simultaneous-engineering concept, element types (requirements, features, tasks, bugs, evals), link types, task status lifecycle, authentication, and configuration requirements.

document:DATA_MODEL.md.name: DATA_MODEL.md
document:DATA_MODEL.md.summary: Detailed data model design documenting the hot-path tables (projects, elements, custom fields, links, attachments, phases, auth), cold-path versioning tables, Go domain types, store interfaces, and the auto-commit versioning flow.

document:README.md.name: README.md
document:README.md.summary: Project overview README with background, installation requirements and steps, app workflow, element types, license, contribution notes, and unit/integration test instructions.

file:TestsResultsParser.sh.name: TestsResultsParser.sh
file:TestsResultsParser.sh.summary: Bash script that parses Go test JSON output with jq into a Markdown summary table for the GitHub Actions step summary, counting passed/failed/skipped tests and failing the job on any failures.

document:backend/DIAGRAM.md.name: DIAGRAM.md
document:backend/DIAGRAM.md.summary: Backend architecture documentation with Mermaid diagrams covering package structure, domain interfaces, cache-backed read flow, the versioning pending-change/commit lifecycle, version reconstruction, authentication, service-layer dependencies, and an API endpoints overview.

config:backend/config.yaml.name: config.yaml
config:backend/config.yaml.summary: Runtime configuration for the backend covering server host/port, database connection, file storage, cache, authentication (including super-admin local account), and versioning behavior.

config:backend/go.mod.name: go.mod
config:backend/go.mod.summary: Go module definition declaring the module path github.com/jerome-godbout-lychens/project_works/backend and pinning the Go 1.23 toolchain.

schema:backend/openapi.yaml.name: openapi.yaml
schema:backend/openapi.yaml.summary: OpenAPI 3 specification defining the complete backend REST contract: auth, projects and folders, elements, links, versions and diffs, attachments, custom field definitions and values, phases, users, groups and membership, project access control, and API keys.

endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:auth.name: auth
endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:auth.summary: Authentication endpoints: OAuth login, callback, logout, and current-user (/auth/login, /auth/callback, /auth/logout, /auth/me).

endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:projects.name: projects
endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:projects.summary: Project and folder management endpoints including listing, creation, folder hierarchy, and per-project retrieval/update (/projects, /projects/folders, /projects/{project_identifier}).

endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:elements.name: elements
endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:elements.summary: Element CRUD and search endpoints scoped to a project, plus standalone element access (/projects/{project_identifier}/elements, /elements/{element_identifier}, /elements/search).

endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:links.name: links
endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:links.summary: Element link management endpoints for creating links from an element and operating on a single link (/elements/{element_identifier}/links, /links/{link_identifier}).

endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:versions.name: versions
endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:versions.summary: Element version history endpoints: list versions, fetch a specific version, and diff between versions (/elements/{element_identifier}/versions[/{version_number}][/diff]).

endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:attachment.name: attachments
endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:attachment.summary: File attachment endpoints for listing/uploading on an element and accessing a single attachment (/elements/{element_identifier}/attachments, /attachments/{attachment_identifier}).

endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:custom-fie.name: custom-fields
endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:custom-fie.summary: Custom field endpoints covering per-project field definitions and per-element field values (/projects/{project_identifier}/custom-field-definitions, /elements/{element_identifier}/custom-field-values).

endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:phases.name: phases
endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:phases.summary: Project phase endpoints for listing/creating phases and operating on a single phase (/projects/{project_identifier}/phases, /phases/{phase_identifier}).

endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:users.name: users
endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:users.summary: User management endpoints for listing users, single-user access, and a user's group memberships (/users, /users/{user_identifier}, /users/{user_identifier}/groups).

endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:groups.name: groups
endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:groups.summary: Group endpoints covering group CRUD, membership management, and group access listings (/groups, /groups/{group_identifier}, /groups/{group_identifier}/members[/{user_identifier}], /groups/{group_identifier}/access).

endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:access.name: access
endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:access.summary: Project access-control endpoints for granting/revoking group access to projects and checking access (/projects/{project_identifier}/access[/{group_identifier}], /projects/{project_identifier}/access/check).

endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:api-keys.name: api-keys
endpoint:backend/openapi.yaml:api-keys.summary: API key endpoints for listing/creating automation keys and operating on a single key (/api-keys, /api-keys/{api_key_identifier}).

file:backend/cmd/integration-test/main.g.name: main.go
file:backend/cmd/integration-test/main.g.summary: Standalone end-to-end integration test harness that drives the running backend's HTTP API, exercising the full lifecycle of projects, elements, links, attachments, versions, phases, custom fields, groups/access, and auth, then emits a markdown test report.

service:Dockerfile_tests.name: Dockerfile_tests
service:Dockerfile_tests.summary: Builds the test container image from golang:1.26-alpine, installing just/gotestsum and tooling, then compiling the integration-test binary used to run unit and integration tests in CI and locally.

file:justfile.name: justfile
file:justfile.summary: Task runner recipes (just) for the project: docker compose lifecycle, local storage cleanup, building the test image, and running unit and integration tests both locally and inside Docker.
